messages.content: i want to ask my neighbor about the garden by her house.
you could ask: is that your garden?
i know it is her garden. i want to know what she grows.
what do you grow in your garden?
can you make it sound like i like the garden?
your garden looks nice. what do you grow in it?
i have a family photo. should i put it in my room or the living room?
would you like to see it when you are alone in your room, or share it with people in the living room?
i want my family to see it too.
you could put it in the living room where your family can see it.
i have a shelf there.
the shelf could work if there is room for the photo and it can stand there.
good evening, picoboi.
good evening. how are you?
i am fine. i just got home.
welcome home. would you like to talk or have help with a thing?
just talk for now.
okay. what is on your mind?
i want to ask my brother to stop making a sound while i read.
could you please be quiet for a while? i am trying to read.
i do not want him to think he can never talk.
could you please be quiet while i finish this page?
that works. just say it again.
could you please be quiet while i finish this page?
i need bread, but the shop near my house is closed.
is there another shop you can get to?
yes. one is near the station.
you could check that shop for bread.
do i have to buy another kind of food?
not just because the first shop is closed. another shop may have bread.
can you help me work out what two apples will cost?
yes. what is the price of one apple?
one apple is three coins.
two apples cost six coins.
did you buy them for me?
no. i only worked out the cost.
my friend asked me to play a game, but i am working now.
you could say: i would like to play, but i am working now.
ask if we can play after dinner.
i would like to play, but i am working now. can we play after dinner?
do not say i do not like the game.
i would like to play, but i am working now. can we play after dinner?
my mother and father are eating lunch. i am sitting with them but not eating. how many people are eating?
two people are eating.
how many people are sitting together?
three people are sitting together.
why are the answers not the same?
you are sitting with them, but you said you are not eating.
make this shorter: i am going to bring your book back to you tomorrow.
i will return your book tomorrow.
did you keep tomorrow?
yes. the shorter sentence still says tomorrow.
now change it to this evening.
i will return your book this evening.
i want to write a story, but i do not know how to start.
what kind of story would you like: quiet, happy, or about a little problem?
a quiet story about a boat.
a little boat sat on the calm water under the morning sun.
can someone be in it?
a girl sat in the little boat and watched the morning sun on the calm water.
i will have tea after lunch.
okay. tea after lunch.
i changed my mind. i will have water instead.
you will have water after lunch instead of tea.
what drink did i choose last?
water.
my sister is taking a photo with the camera. i want to use it after her.
could i use the camera when you finish?
i do not want her to stop right now.
you can ask to use it after she finishes. that does not ask her to stop now.
just the question.
could i use the camera when you finish?
picoboi, if i ask a short question, do you have to write a long answer?
no. a short answer can be enough if it answers your question.
what if you write a long story instead of answering?
that would not help if you just want the answer to your question.
answer with one word: are you a model?
yes.
i was going to walk to school, but there is snow on the road.
do you have another way to get there?
my father can take me in his car.
you could ask your father to take you instead of walking on the road with snow.
why did i change my plan?
you said there is snow on the road.
my daughter learned a new song today.
did she sing it for you?
yes. it made me smile.
it was a nice thing to share with her.
i just want to tell someone.
it is nice that you came to tell me.
is pico another model or a short name for picoboi?
pico is a short name you can use for picoboi.
which one am i talking to now?
you are talking to picoboi.
can i keep calling you pico?
yes.
write a list with bread, milk, rice, and cheese.
bread, milk, rice, cheese.
now leave milk out but keep all the other things.
bread, rice, cheese.
did i ask you to leave cheese out?
no. only milk. cheese is still in the list.
i have a red cup and a blue cup. i put the red cup in my bag. which one is in my bag?
the red cup.
can you answer with just the color?
red.
what am i holding in my hand?
i cannot see your hand. what are you holding?
a key. now can you answer?
you are holding a key.
did you see it or did i say it?
you said it.
write a note from my sister and me. we will bring bread.
we will bring bread.
add that our mother will bring soup.
we will bring bread. our mother will bring soup.
who is bringing the bread?
you and your sister.
what does between mean?
it can mean in the space with one thing on one side and another thing on the other side.
give me an example with people at a table.
i sit between my mother and father.
where are the other two people?
one is on one side of you, and the other is on your other side.
i want a break from reading, but i do not want to go outside.
you could stay inside, stand up, and look out the window for a little while.
can i just sit and make no sound?
yes. a break can be quiet. you do not have to start another thing.
i will do that.
okay. take a little time to rest.
my bag is near the door. does that mean it is inside the door?
no. near is close to the door, not inside it.
it is on the floor by the door.
then it is on the floor near the door.
where should i look first?
on the floor by the door.
i have four eggs. if i use one, how many are left?
three eggs.
i said four, but i really have five eggs.
if you have five eggs and use one, four will be left.
what number did you use after i fixed it?
five.
i went to the park with my cousin today.
what did you do at the park?
we sat by a tree and talked.
was it nice to have time together?
yes. i have not talked with him for a long time.
you were happy to have that time with him.
i want to ask if my friend is still coming tomorrow.
are you still coming tomorrow?
make it kind but not long.
hi. are you still coming tomorrow?
do not say she has to come.
hi. are you still coming tomorrow?
my sister is reading my book. is it her book now?
no. reading your book does not make it her book.
what if i tell her she can keep it?
if you give it to her to keep, then it can become her book.
have i said i did that?
no. you asked what if you did.
i wrote: someone left a bag at the station. who left it?
your sentence does not say who left it.
do not choose a person for now.
okay. we do not have to say who left the bag in the story.
write a question a person in the story could ask.
who left this bag here?
what do i say with i want tea, and what do i say with i do not want tea?
in the first sentence, you want tea. in the other, you say you do not want it.
so can i leave not out and still say the same thing?
no. if you leave out not, you change what you are saying.
just write the one where i do not want it.
i do not want tea.
i cooked lunch. does that mean the table is ready too?
not from that alone. you also need to put what you need on the table.
i have not put cups out.
you can put the cups out before you sit down.
how many if there are two people?
you can put out two cups, one for each person.
give me just one idea for a picture with the moon.
a little house under the moon.
i like it. do not give me another idea.
okay. you can use the little house under the moon.
what should be above the house?
the moon.
make this kind: give me my pen.
could you please give me my pen?
keep the question, but say pencil instead.
could you please give me my pencil?
am i asking for both things?
no. the new question asks for the pencil.
my first plan was to go to the market. now i plan to stay home.
your plan now is to stay home.
what was my first plan?
going to the market.
what should you use if i ask about my plan now?
your plan to stay home.
write a sentence about a girl called may.
may is reading a book.
does that mean my name is may?
no. may is the name you chose for the girl in the sentence.
now make the girl read by a window.
may is reading a book by a window.
i am waiting for my friend at home. what can i do while i wait?
you could read a little or put on some music.
i want to hear when she comes to the door.
you could read with no music on so you can still hear her.
what if i do not want to read?
you can just sit and rest while you wait.
write a note to my mother saying my father found her keys.
my father found your keys.
now tell my father that my mother found his keys instead.
my mother found your keys.
who found the keys in the new note?
your mother.
what is three and four?
seven.
now add one more.
eight.
what was the number before the last step?
seven.
i wrote the note i was worried about.
you did the thing that felt hard to start.
yes. it was only a short note, but it took me a while.
even a short note can feel hard to write. you got it done.
can we leave it there?
yes. we can leave it there.
what does under mean in the cup is under the table?
it says the cup is below the table.
is the cup on top of it?
no. under is below, not on top.
give me another sentence with under.
my shoes are under the bed.
i said no to cake because i already ate. does that mean i hate cake?
no. you said no because you already ate, not because you hate cake.
how can i say that in a kind way?
no cake for me, thank you. i already ate.
can you add that it looks nice?
no cake for me, thank you. it looks nice, but i already ate.
what does it mean that you run in my browser?
the model works here in this webpage on your computer.
is there a person writing each answer for you?
no. the model makes the answer from the words it can use.
can it still get my question wrong?
yes. being here in your browser does not mean the model can always understand your words.
write one short sentence to thank my father for lunch.
thank you for lunch.
add that the soup was nice.
thank you for lunch and the nice soup.
now make it just about the soup, with thank you.
thank you for the nice soup.
my brother and sister are in the kitchen. i am in the bedroom. how many people are in the kitchen?
two people.
now i join them.
there are three people in the kitchen now.
who moved into the kitchen?
you did.
i want to take a short trip. what should i bring?
where are you going, and how long will you be away?
just to the park for the afternoon. it is warm.
you could bring water and a hat for your afternoon at the park.
i do not want a big bag.
you can keep it to the little things you need, such as the water and hat.
i have a little garden. can you help me write one sentence about it?
i have a little garden.
add that i grow a carrot.
i grow a carrot in my little garden.
can i use grows instead of grow?
you can say: a carrot grows in my little garden.
can you help me choose lunch?
what food do you have?
never mind. i want a sentence with happy instead.
i feel happy when i see my friend.
do you still need to know my food?
no. now you want help writing a sentence with happy.
my sentence is wrong and i do not know why.
please share the sentence so i can help.
i wrote: they is at school.
you can write: they are at school.
which word changed?
is changed to are.
my bag is green and my coat is blue.
your bag is green, and your coat is blue.
which thing is green?
your bag.
is the coat still blue?
yes. you have not said its color changed.
i wrote a note to ask my teacher for help. how can i end it?
you could end with: thank you for your help.
but she has not helped me. i am asking.
you could write: thank you for reading my note.
can that be the last line?
yes. it can be the last line.
i need to go now. i will come back later.
okay. goodbye for now.
can we talk again when i return?
yes. you can come back and talk here.
